'''Xarval''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who held the position of vice [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] aboard the ''[[Theoretika]]'', a mobile [[research vessel|research starship]] operated by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] over a century before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. When the ship was damaged and stuck out in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], Xarval found the engines to be completely useless, and was angry to find that non-emergency power was being shunted to the ship's research labs. As [[Time/Legends|time]] went on, Xarval and other crewmembers suspected Chief [[Diirn]] of hoarding food in the lab, but when they broke into the lab, Xarval and the others were killed by [[Specimen Gamma 19]].
